faqs.answer: Panels: 10-25 year warranty. Inverters: 2-5 years. Batteries: 2-10 years depending on type. Installation workmanship: 12 months.
Installation usually takes 1-2 days after a site visit. A technician confirms panel placement, wiring and the right system size before we start.
We accept a deposit to book (typically 50-70%) with the balance on installation. Ask our team about payment plans.
Solar needs very little care: rinse panels now and then and have the system checked once a year. We offer service plans.
Batteries store power for the night and cloudy periods. Panels still make some power on cloudy days, just less.

It depends on what you want to run. Tell us your appliances (fridge, TV, lights, borehole pump, geyser) and how many hours a day, and we will size the panels, inverter and battery for you. Reply *menu* and choose a quote.
Price depends on the system size and the brands. Reply *menu* to see our packages, or ask for a free quote and we will send a written price.

A hybrid system keeps your lights, TV, fridge and Wi-Fi running during power cuts, using solar and battery. It can also use ZESA when available. Ask for a quote sized to the loads you want to keep on.

Geysers, stoves, heaters and air conditioners use a lot of power. They can run on solar, but they need a bigger system. Tell us what you want to run and we will size it. A solar geyser is often a cheaper option.
Yes, we can power a borehole pump with solar. We need the pump size (kW or HP), the depth and the daily water you need. A site visit confirms the best design.

Lithium batteries last longer, are lighter and can be discharged deeper. Gel or lead-acid batteries cost less up front but need replacing sooner. We recommend based on your budget and how much power you use at night.

Hybrid inverters work with solar, battery and the grid. Off-grid systems run on solar and battery only. Grid-tie systems have no backup during a power cut. For homes with outages we usually recommend hybrid.

Fair question. Always ask any installer for company registration, past installations you can visit, brand warranty papers and a written quote. We are happy to share these. Reply *menu* to talk to our team.
We supply quality panels, inverters and batteries from well-known brands. The exact brands depend on the package and stock. Ask for a quote and we will list every item and its warranty.
Savings depend on how much you spend on power and fuel now. Many customers recover the cost within a few years. Share your monthly electricity or generator spend and we will estimate it.
A technician visits to check the roof, shade, wiring and your loads, then confirms the system size. Reply *menu* to book a visit or request a quote.
Panels work best facing north with little shade. Most roof types work. We check the roof and shade at the site visit and mount the panels at the best angle.
Panels typically last 25 years or more. Inverters often last 8-12 years. Batteries last roughly 3-5 years for gel and 8-10 years for lithium, depending on use.
Reply *menu* and choose to speak to our team, and we will share our contact details and arrange a call or visit.
